note: A client-rendered app whose application bundle was never captured with it. Scores zero for both providers, and the two zeros mean different things: the static provider cannot run scripts, and the browser has no script to run — `/assets/index-4f9a2c.js` 404s, so `#root` stays empty however long Chromium waits. Kept deliberately, because it is the honest demonstration that a frozen snapshot of a single-page app is only as good as the assets frozen alongside it. The fix is to capture such pages post-render (`--snapshot --render`), not to loosen the ground truth. See `hydrated-profile` for the same shape captured completely.
